description: Add/remove labels on a thread. Archive = remove 'INBOX'; mark read = remove 'UNREAD'. Labels may be given by name or by id: an unknown name in `add` is created automatically (use '/' for nested labels), an unknown name in `remove` is ignored. USE WHEN: applying custom labels or label combinations in one call. DO NOT USE: for plain archive/read/unread — the dedicated tools are clearer. Pass `threadIds` (a list of up to 100) instead of `threadId` to apply the same change to every listed thread in one call — for 'exactly these threads, as approved'. The answer then reports per thread: `changed`, `failed` (with code and message; the others still ran) and `notAttempted` (the run stopped at a rate limit, dead token or missing scope, which would have hit every remaining thread alike); `ok` is true only when all were changed. SIDE EFFECTS: changes the thread's labels (and may create a label named in `add`, once per call even for a list); reversible by the inverse call.
name: modify_labels
